properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 12 at 12:32PM EDT by NWS Peachtree City GA
properties.description:
...The National Weather Service in Peachtree City GA has issued a
Flood Warning for the following rivers in Georgia...

Nickajack Creek at US 278 near Mableton affecting Cobb County.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring.

* WHERE...Nickajack Creek at US 278 near Mableton.

* WHEN...From this afternoon until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 10.0 feet, Flood stage is reached. Minor flooding will
occur in the woodlands and the natural flood plain upstream and
downstream from the gage at Veterans Memorial Highway. Portions of
Nickajack Park will begin to flood around one mile upstream from
the gage.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 12:00 PM EDT Saturday the stage was 10.2 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 12:00 PM EDT Saturday was 10.2 feet.
- Forecast...No forecast is available for this location.
- Flood stage is 10.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 10.2
feet on 12/30/2021.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Additional information is available at weather.gov/atlanta.

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued September 12 at 11:16AM CDT until September 12 at 12:45PM CDT by NWS New Orleans LA
properties.description:
SMWLIX

The National Weather Service in New Orleans has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Terrebonne Bay...
Coastal Waters from Port Fourchon LA to Lower Atchafalaya River LA
out 20 nm...
Coastal waters from Port Fourchon Louisiana to Lower Atchafalaya
River LA from 20 to 60 NM...

* Until 1245 PM CDT.

* At 1116 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing
waterspouts was located 14 NM south of Timbalier Island, moving
east at 5 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts to 34 knots.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Isle Derniers, Timbalier Island, Caillou Bay, Terrebonne Bay and
Timbalier Bay.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 12 at 11:38AM CDT until September 12 at 12:30PM CDT by NWS Omaha/Valley NE
properties.description:
SVROAX

The National Weather Service in Omaha has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Southern Pawnee County in southeastern Nebraska...

* Until 1230 PM CDT.

* At 1138 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 3 miles south of
Burchard, or 10 miles west of Pawnee City, moving east at 40 mph.

HAZARD...Quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Damage to vehicles is expected.

* This severe thunderstorm will be near...
Pawnee City around 1150 AM CDT.
Du Bois around 1155 AM CDT.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 12 at 11:43AM CDT until September 12 at 11:45AM CDT by NWS Omaha/Valley NE
properties.description:
The storm which prompted the warning has moved out of the area.
Therefore, the warning will be allowed to expire.

To report severe weather, contact your nearest law enforcement
agency. They will relay your report to the National Weather Service
Omaha.

Remember, a Severe Thunderstorm Warning still remains in effect for
southern Pawnee County until 1230 pm CDT.

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued September 12 at 11:52AM EDT until September 12 at 1:45PM EDT by NWS Tallahassee FL
properties.description:
SMWTAE

The National Weather Service in Tallahassee has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Apalachee Bay or Coastal Waters From Keaton Beach to Ochlockonee
River Fl out to 20 Nm...
Coastal Waters From  Ochlockonee River to Apalachicola FL out to 20
Nm...
Coastal waters from  Suwannee River to Keaton Beach out 20 NM...
Waters from Suwannee River to Apalachicola FL from 20 to 60 NM...

* Until 145 PM EDT.

* At 1151 AM EDT, a cluster of strong thunderstorms capable of
producing waterspouts were located along a line extending from 8
nm north of O Tower to near Suwannee River, moving east at 25
knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can quickly form and capsize boats...damage
vessels...and create suddenly higher waves. Make sure all
on board are in a secure location and wearing life
jackets. Expect wind gusts in excess of 34
knots...suddenly higher waves...frequent lightning...and
heavy downpours. Make sure all on board are wearing life
jackets.

* Locations impacted include...
Buckeye Reef, Horseshoe Beach, K Tower, Marker 24 Barge, and
Suwannee River.
